summary: Toronto Parking Authority seeks to retain Toronto Hydro-Electric System Limited to deploy and operate thirty-two electric vehicle chargers at Toronto Parking Authority-operated facilities. Toronto Parking Authority is requesting authority to enter into two (2) agreements, one (1) for the retention of Toronto Hydro-Electric System Limited with respect to nine (9) Electric Vehicle chargers that will replace the existing Electric Vehicle charging equipment that Toronto Parking Authority has in place at three (3) Toronto Parking Authority facilities; and the other for Toronto Hydro-Electric System Limited 's retention with respect to twenty-three (23) Electric Vehicle charges at other locations within Toronto Parking Authority facilities. The purpose of this report is to provide Toronto Parking Authority Board of Directors with an update on the status of Toronto Parking Authority's Electric Vehicle Charging Pilot Project and to seek authority to include new and amended terms and conditions in the agreements needed to enable Toronto Parking Authority 's retention of Toronto Hydro-Electric System Limited to provide the necessary goods and services to install the Electric Vehicle charging stations and operate for a three (3)-year period, the Electric Vehicle charging stations as a Toronto Parking Authority service provider. decided: The Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Authorized the President, Toronto Parking Authority to, negotiate, enter into, and execute on behalf of Toronto Parking Authority, two (2) agreements with Toronto Hydro-Electric System Limited to provide the goods and services necessary for Toronto Hydro-Electric System Limited to operate as a service provider to the Toronto Parking Authority for a three (3)-year period, two separate collections of specific electric vehicle charging infrastructure stations within parking facilities operated by Toronto Parking Authority, in accordance with the updated terms and conditions contained in Attachment A to the report (November 4, 2021) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority, and any such other or amended terms and conditions as may be acceptable to the President, Toronto Parking Authority, and in a form satisfactory to the City Solicitor.
